verdict.rationale: Authorization Stream Access lets your own system make custom real-time approval decisions on each authorization over HTTP, which covers the 'my system approves each authorization' half of a just-in-time model. Nothing in the evidence describes funding mechanics, prefunded balances, a choice between funding models, or their cash-flow tradeoffs. Missing for 10: documented prefunded-balance funding, JIT funding of each authorization (not just approval), a selectable funding-model choice, cash-flow tradeoff documentation, independent corroboration.
